module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 1000, so executed last) reserved for child graphs created by a foreach loop. It contains only the fields parentGraphId, key and value, which the foreach node fills in for the child. All its execution methods are empty.
notes: afterTrigger, executionStopped and executionStarted are empty (a debug log is commented out).

init.desc: Called when the module is created: calls clear().

clear.desc: Resets parentGraphId, key and value to nil.

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick (does nothing).

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops (does nothing).

executionStarted.desc: Called when the project starts (does nothing).
